lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu guramukh paaeeai anadin naam laei ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! This is obtained by the Gurmukhs, who hold tight to the Naam, night and day. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve saat na aavaee doojee naahee jaai ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained, and the sense of duality does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai vin karamai na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: No matter how much one may wish, without the Lord's Grace, He is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai doojai bhaai khuaai ||
lines.translation: Those who are filled with greed and corruption are ruined by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran na chukaee haumai vich dukh paai ||
lines.translation: They cannot escape birth and death, and with egotism within them, they suffer in misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa satigur siu chit laaiaa s khaalee koee naahi ||
lines.translation: Those who center their consciousness on the True Guru, never go empty-handed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin jam kee talab na hovaee naa oi dukh sahaahi ||
lines.translation: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare sachai sabad samaahi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they merge in the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee tis no aakheeai j khasamai dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: He alone is called a minstrel, who enshrines love for his Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਖੜਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar khaRaa sevaa kare gurasabadee veechaar ||
lines.translation: Standing at the Lord's Door, he serves the Lord, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee dar ghar paaisee sach rakhai ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: The minstrel attains the Lord's Gate and Mansion, and he keeps the True Lord clasped to his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee kaa mahal agalaa har kai naai piaar ||
lines.translation: The status of the minstrel is exalted; he loves the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee kee sevaa chaakaree har jap har nisataar ||18||
lines.translation: The service of the minstrel is to meditate on the Lord; he is emancipated by the Lord. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree jaat gavaar jaa sahu paae aapanaa ||
lines.translation: The milkmaid's status is very low, but she attains her Husband Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaar anadin har jap jaapanaa ||
lines.translation: when she reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and chants the Lord's Name, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis satigur milai tis bhau pavai saa kulava(n)tee naar ||
lines.translation: She who meets the True Guru, lives in the Fear of God; she is a woman of noble birth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੰਤ ਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa hukam pachhaanai ka(n)t kaa jis no kripaa keetee karataar ||
lines.translation: She alone realizes the Hukam of her Husband Lord's Command, who is blessed by the Creator Lord's Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oh kuchajee kulakhanee parahar chhodee bhataar ||
lines.translation: She who is of little merit and ill-mannered, is discarded and forsaken by her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai paiai mal kateeai niramal hovai sareer ||
lines.translation: By the Fear of God, filth is washed off, and the body becomes immaculately pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar paragaas mat ootam hovai har jap gunee gaheer ||
lines.translation: The soul is enlightened, and the intellect is exalted, meditating on the Lord, the ocean of excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਭੈ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai vich baisai bhai rahai bhai vich kamaavai kaar ||
lines.translation: One who dwells in the Fear of God, lives in the Fear of God, and acts in the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai sukh vadiaaeeaa daragah mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: He obtains peace and glorious greatness here, in the Lord's Court, and at the Gate of Salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai te nirabhau paaeeai mil jotee jot apaar ||
lines.translation: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and one's light merges in the Infinite Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak khasamai bhaavai saa bhalee jis no aape bakhase karataar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that bride alone is good, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master, and whom the Creator Lord Himself forgives. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai sache kau bal jaau ||
lines.translation: Praise the Lord, forever and ever, and make yourself a sacrifice to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ek chhod doojai lagai saa jihavaa jal jaau ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, let that tongue be burnt, which renounces the One Lord, and attaches itself to another. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਸਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)saa autaar upaaion bhaau doojaa keeaa ||
lines.translation: From a single particle of His greatness, He created His incarnations, but they indulged in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭਿੜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu raaje raaj kamaavade dukh sukh bhiReeaa ||
lines.translation: They ruled like kings, and fought for pleasure and pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: eesar brahamaa sevade a(n)t tinhee na laheeaa ||
lines.translation: Those who serve Shiva and Brahma do not find the limits of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar alakh hai guramukh pragateeaa ||
lines.translation: The Fearless, Formless Lord is unseen and invisible; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: tithai sog vijog na viaapaee asathir jag theeaa ||19||
lines.translation: There, one does not suffer sorrow or separation; he becomes stable and immortal in the world. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu sabh kichh aavan jaan hai jetaa hai aakaar ||
lines.translation: All these things come and go, all these things of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ehu lekhaa likhiaa so hoaa paravaan ||
lines.translation: One who knows this written account is acceptable and approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak je ko aap ganaaidaa so moorakh gaavaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, anyone who takes pride in himself is foolish and unwise. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਪੀਲਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜਹ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ku(n)char peelak guroo giaan ku(n)daa jah khi(n)che tah jaai ||
lines.translation: The mind is the elephant, the Guru is the elephant-driver, and knowledge is the whip. Wherever the Guru drives the mind, it goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hasatee ku(n)de baaharaa phir phir ujhaR paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the whip, the elephant wanders into the wilderness, again and again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis aagai aradaas jin upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I offer my prayer to the One, from whom I was created.
